bagPolicy.summary: Camp Randall Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to enhance security. Only specific types of bags are allowed, and all other items are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Camp Randall Stadium Parking offers convenient parking services for visitors, located at 1595 Engineering Dr. It provides a hassle-free parking experience for events and games, with operating hours from 9 am to 6 pm on weekdays.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Camp Randall Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Camp Randall Stadium varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available at all events; request one on the day. FM assistive listening headsets are at the Guest Services Office on the South End Zone 1st level concourse, with an ID or credit card left as collateral. For football games, golf carts and the Bucky Shuttle serve accessible pick-up locations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Camp Randall Stadium has a no re-entry policy. Once you leave during an event, you can't return with that ticket. In an emergency, contact Guest Services or the nearest usher.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Badgers games, tickets are mobile and scanned on your phone, and they can't be printed. Download them before you arrive; the Badgers App is the fastest way to access them. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Camp Randall Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
